evidence: processing your personal data
reason: The segment is a bare noun phrase with no subject, verb, or surrounding context, so it cannot establish who processes personal data or whether an affirmative practice is stated.

evidence: Processing for which Criteo, advertisers, and/or publishers act as joint data controllers
Consent collected by advertisers and publishers on their websites, apps or other platforms.
reason: Reading the device identifier is listed under processing jointly controlled by Criteo, advertisers, and/or publishers through Criteo technology. Advertisers appear only as collectors of consent, so naming advertisers alone as the reader names a different party and drops Criteo.

evidence: if you use one of the following services: PayPal and PayPal Honey; we may associate information about your transactions and experiences using these services
reason: The claim matches the sentence: Venmo may associate transaction and experience information from PayPal and PayPal Honey, conditioned on using those services, to personalize content and improve Venmo.

evidence: If you choose to login to the Amplitude platform with Google
Google may share with us your email, name, and your unique Google ID so we can identify and authenticate you as a user
reason: Google shares the user's email with Amplitude when the user logs in with Google API services, for identification and authentication. Actor, recipient, condition, and purpose are supported.

evidence: The disclosure of your personal information to these third-parties to assist us in providing these services may be considered a
click on the Your Privacy Choices link located in the footer of our Website
reason: The actor is the article 'The' instead of the company. The disclosure to advertising and analytics third parties, its possible sale characterization, the purpose, and the opt-out exceptions are supported, so the error is confined to the actor field.

evidence: The types of information we may collect include your name, email address, postal address, phone number
reason: The segment lists phone number among information Flickr may collect from users. The listed collection occasions are introduced as examples and do not limit the practice.

evidence: we also use AppsFlyer for a separate functional purpose to help join up the onboarding process between the Website and App for some users
processing of your personal data for this purpose
reason: The condition leaves 'for this purpose' unresolved. The text limits non-optional AppsFlyer processing to joining onboarding between Website and App for some users, while other AppsFlyer sharing depends on consent. The unrestricted claim loses this limit.

evidence: the processing of Personal Data it receives under the DPF
reason: GitLab Inc. states that it receives Personal Data under the DPF from the EU, UK, and Switzerland. The receiving action and the DPF condition are supported.

evidence: To do this we typically need to pass wallet address(s) or transactional data to these service providers in order to help users interact with the blockchain.
reason: Brave states it typically passes wallet addresses to the third-party blockchain service providers to help users interact with the blockchain. The claim keeps the hedge, recipient, and purpose.

evidence: HugeDomains may require customers to provide government identification and/or other documentation as proof of identity and physical address
reason: The operation label (collection from customers), data type, proof-of-identity use, and protective purpose match the text. The verb 'provide' describes the customers' act, but the stated operation is correct.

evidence: should the User provide the Website or the Entity with an email address or any other means of electronic communication, the User expressly authorizes the Entity to use such means
reason: The Entity may use a provided email address to reply to requests, send news, and announce website changes, conditioned on the user providing it. All fields are supported.

evidence: This Privacy Statement describes how we may share your information for marketing purposes
reason: The segment states Michaels may share user information for marketing purposes. No condition in the segment limits this statement.

evidence: Compliance with a Legal Obligation:
To detect, prevent, or otherwise address fraud and abuse to protect you, GitLab, and third-parties
reason: Under the legal-obligation basis, the fraud-prevention purpose lists Profile Information, so data type, basis, and purpose are supported. The actor is the article 'The' instead of GitLab.

evidence: Information that may be collected by cookies when you use the Sites may include
You may set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies.
reason: Cookie collection of browser type and version when using the Sites is supported. The exception wrongly includes setting controls to accept cookies, since only refusing cookies would stop collection. The counterparty 'from by cookies' names a mechanism, not a party.

evidence: You can stop all collection of precise location data through an app by uninstalling the app or withdrawing your consent through your device settings.
reason: The text implies JetBlue collects precise location data through its app, stopped by uninstalling the app or withdrawing consent in device settings. The claim captures the practice and both exceptions with correct logic.

evidence: third party advertising companies which deliver cookies to your computer or device so the advertisements you see can be tracked
to stop accepting cookies or to prompt you before accepting a cookie
reason: Actor, cookies, device, and tracking purpose are supported. Treating a browser prompt as an exception is imprecise, because cookies the user accepts at the prompt are still delivered. Only refusing cookies stops delivery.

evidence: Moneycontrol only collects the necessary personally identifiable information in order to respond to your requests for our customized products and services.
reason: The claim restates the sentence: Moneycontrol collects necessary PII to respond to requests for customized products and services. The purpose limit is kept.

evidence: we process your IP address, which we translate into non-precise location data
reason: Outbrain states it translates the user's IP address into non-precise location data. The action and data type match.

evidence: automatically generated email data used to improve our email communications
reason: The White House states that automatically generated email data is used to improve its email communications. The use and purpose match.

evidence: device aggregated as part of our Analytics and Reporting program by going to our
reason: The opt-out sentence implies T-Mobile aggregates device data in its Analytics and Reporting program unless the user opts out through the Privacy Dashboard. The exception wording is loose but carries the right meaning.

evidence: We transfer your personal information to parties in countries outside the country in which it was collected, including but not limited to the USA, as permitted or required by applicable law
reason: The claim restates the sentence, including the recipients abroad and the permitted-or-required-by-law condition.

evidence: We retain personal information as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which that information was collected in accordance with our internal retention policies
reason: Hilton retains personal information as necessary for the collection purpose, per internal policies, usually for the consented period or contract duration plus legally required periods. The condition text is supported.

evidence: The Company will acknowledge receipt of the grievance promptly and will endeavour to investigate and resolve it within a reasonable timeframe.
reason: The sentence concerns resolving user grievances, not a data practice. The attribute 'it' is an unresolved pronoun for the grievance, 'use' misstates resolving, and the hedge 'endeavour' is lost.

evidence: Information about your interests in and use of various products, programs, and services
The personal information we collect and use for this purpose includes:
reason: Under the advertising and marketing purpose, Activision lists information about interests in and use of products as personal information provided by the user. Data, source, and purposes are supported.

evidence: subject to your settings and preferences, and your right to opt-out
marketing and advertising partners, analytics providers, and social networks
reason: In the section for residents of the listed states, the company may sell or share identifiers such as name with social networks, subject to settings and the right to opt out. The claim reflects these conditions.

evidence: In all of the above cases and purposes, we may analyze, profile and segment all collected data.
reason: Supercell states it may analyze, profile, and segment all collected data in all listed cases. The claim matches.

evidence: Share information with the party which pays for Parking Sessions on your Account
to the extent that such data relates to the use of third-party payment method added to your Account
reason: PayByPhone shares parking and transaction data including financial information with the paying party after permitted account linking, limited to data on the third-party payment method, for verification and reports. All fields are supported.

evidence: We share your information internally at Stanford to facilitate and manage the purposes listed above.
reason: The claim restates the sentence, including the internal recipient and the purpose.

evidence: We may share employees information with;
Social Welfare
reason: Social Welfare is listed among recipients of employees information. Actor, data type, and recipient are supported.

evidence: Certain data is collected automatically.
Data about your device, such as device name and operating system, browser type and language;
reason: Device data is collected automatically on the stated internal-operations bases. The empty actor is the policy owner implied by the passive sentence.

evidence: collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you use Canva
reason: The policy states Canva and its affiliates protect information when users use the Service or interact with Canva, and the policy applies to all users including Developer Portal users.

evidence: We may also collect this information from Third Parties, such as social networks.
reason: The attribute 'this information' is unresolved. In the source it refers to the Personal Characteristics category, and several categories are collected from social networks, so the claim names no identifiable data type.

evidence: we will use the minimum amount necessary to accomplish a purpose authorized by statute, executive order, or regulation.
reason: The condition and purpose match. The attribute 'minimum amount necessary' omits the data type, the PII users post or send to GovDelivery, though the condition lets a reader recover it.

evidence: Slack may transfer your Personal Data to countries other than the one in which you live, including transfers to the United States.
reason: The claim restates the sentence. The destination appears in the condition instead of the counterparty, which is a harmless format difference.

evidence: To register for an Account, you
provide us with a valid email address, name, as well as your age and gender.
reason: Users must provide their name to Audiomack to register for an account. Collection by the company on registration is supported.

evidence: We may also disclose information about you where there is a lawful basis for doing so
reason: The condition reproduces the sentence: lawful basis, necessity to enforce terms or protect operations or users, or a reorganization, merger, or sale.

evidence: In addition to processing online communications, conduct, demographics, transcript and enrollment data, this application processes inputs
reason: Enrollment data processing is supported. The actor 'this application' is unresolved; the segment describes several applications, and this one is PowerSchool CCLR (Naviance).

evidence: may combine this information with other personal information we collect from you
reason: The fragment states the site may combine information with other personal information it collects. The domain as actor is the policy owner.

evidence: in certain cases, we may process your information where necessary for the purposes of our legitimate interests or the legitimate interests of third parties
reason: Yahoo states it may process information on the legitimate-interests basis where not overridden by user rights. The claim matches.

evidence: IP address (processed in real time, not stored)
reason: The segment states Voodoo processes IP address in real time. The row's purpose falls before the segment, and the not-stored detail is a separate practice.

evidence: In order to provide a better service to you, we may collect and process the following data about you:
length of visits to certain pages
reason: Length of visits to pages is listed as Usage Data collected to provide better service when users use or visit the platform. All fields are supported.

evidence: By law we have to keep basic information about our customers (including Contact, Identity, Financial and Transaction Data) after our customers cease being customers.
reason: The company keeps basic customer information after the customer relationship ends. The legal requirement is the stated reason and does not narrow when the practice applies.

evidence: We may use the information collected from you from various sources to prevent fraud and illegal use of our service.
reason: Use of collected information to prevent fraud and illegal use is supported. The duplicated 'from' in the source field is a formatting artifact.

evidence: When we transfer Personal Data out of the European Union
reason: Cisco states it transfers Personal Data out of the EU, EEA, UK, Gibraltar, and Switzerland to countries without adequacy decisions under safeguards. The claim captures the transfer and its origin.

evidence: Before your cruise, We may collect certain information about your medical history
We may collect information at the point of purchase of your cruise ticket, through the online check in process, and/or via the app.
reason: In the sensitive-data paragraph, the information collected at ticket purchase, online check-in, or via the app is medical history and health information. The generic attribute 'information' drops this sensitive data type.

evidence: we may use this deidentified data for those purposes permitted under applicable law
reason: The claim restates the sentence, including the deidentified data and the purposes permitted by law.

evidence: Any biometric data we collect from you will be deleted within 48 hours
reason: Under eyeglass virtual try-on, biometric data is deleted within 48 hours. The empty actor is the policy owner implied by the passive sentence.

evidence: nearby WiFi access points
to perform and enhance the functions of ASUS products and services
reason: ASUS may collect location data including nearby WiFi access points to perform and enhance product functions. The claim matches.

evidence: may collect non-personal identification information about Users whenever Users interact with our Site
reason: The claim restates the fragment, including the condition that users interact with the site.

evidence: If you are purchasing something using the web
These details are transferred to a secure, online payment service, hosted outside WHO.
reason: Credit card details provided for web purchases are transferred to an external payment service. Data, recipient, and condition are supported.
